market.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
market.rules_primary: If the FDA announces Reclassification of BPC-157 to Category 1 of the Bulk Drug Substances List before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
market.rules_secondary:
The Payout Criterion is satisfied by placement of BPC-157 in either Category 1 or Category 1 Bulk Drug Substances Under Evaluation on the 503A Bulk Drug Substances list, as either designation restores compounding eligibility. 
Removal from Category 2 alone, without placement in Category 1, does not satisfy the Payout Criterion.
market.title: When will FDA announce Reclassification of BPC-157 to Category 1 of the Bulk Drug Substances List?
